svg.title: claude-code-statusline
svg.desc: A four-line status line under the Claude Code prompt: model and context bar, rate limits with pace, git state of the current repo, and a fox companion commenting on uncommitted files.

g.text: A four-line dashboard for the bottom of your Claude Code terminal.
